skill.name: inbox-workflow
skill.desc: Forward-looking items that feed into conversations. Flat directory, frontmatter-driven state.
skill.overview:
The inbox holds items needing attention - ideas, bugs, questions, requests. Each item is a markdown file with frontmatter tracking its status and outcomes. Items flow into conversations via Saddle compilation, and out of conversations come tickets, skills, specs, or more inbox items.
This replaces the old mail-workflow directory shuffling with frontmatter-as-state.
skill.structure:
``` META/inbox/ 20251227-1030-feature-idea.md 20251227-1100-bug-report.md 20251227-1400-refactor-question.md ```
Single flat directory. No subdirectories for state. Frontmatter carries everything.
Filename format: `YYYYMMDD-HHMM-slug.md`

frontmatter.minimal: Fresh item, just landed: ```yaml --- status: pending --- ```
frontmatter.processing: Selected for a conversation: ```yaml --- status: processing profile: kickoff project: myproject tags: [feature, ui] --- ```
frontmatter.done_single: Processed, single outcome: ```yaml --- status: done profile: kickoff project: myproject tags: [feature, ui] processed_at: 2025-12-27 outcome: ticket outcome_ref: META/tickets/todo/dark-mode.md --- ```
frontmatter.done_multiple: Processed, multiple outcomes: ```yaml --- status: done profile: kickoff project: myproject processed_at: 2025-12-27 outcomes: - type: ticket ref: META/tickets/todo/refactor-theme.md - type: skill ref: main/skills/theming.xml action: created - type: inbox ref: META/inbox/20251227-1400-followup.md notes: "Split into multiple pieces" --- ```
frontmatter.done_none: Processed, no artifact needed: ```yaml --- status: done processed_at: 2025-12-27 outcome: none notes: "Fixed directly, one-line change" --- ```
frontmatter.deferred: Blocked or waiting: ```yaml --- status: deferred deferred_at: 2025-12-27 deferred_reason: "Waiting for upstream release" tags: [blocked] --- ```

fields.status: Required. One of: - `pending` - Not yet processed - `processing` - Currently in a conversation - `done` - Processed, has outcome - `deferred` - Blocked or postponed
fields.profile: Optional. Which Saddle profile to compile with. Common values: `kickoff`, `reflection`, `ticket-work`.
fields.project: Optional. Which project this belongs to. Resolved via Saddle's project catalog.
fields.tags: Optional. Array of arbitrary tags for filtering. Examples: `[bug, ui, priority-high]`, `[feature, backend]`, `[question, blocked]`.
fields.outcome: Set when done. Single outcome type: - `ticket` - Created a ticket - `skill` - Created or updated a skill - `spec` - Updated a spec file - `inbox` - Spawned another inbox item - `none` - No artifact, handled directly
fields.outcome_ref: Path to the created artifact, if applicable.
fields.outcomes: For multiple outcomes, use array instead of single `outcome`: ```yaml outcomes: - type: ticket ref: META/tickets/todo/slug.md - type: skill ref: main/skills/name.xml action: created | updated ```
fields.notes: Optional. Free-form notes about what was decided.

skill.lifecycle: 1. **Create**: Write item to `META/inbox/YYYYMMDD-HHMM-slug.md` with `status: pending` 2. **Select**: In Saddle, select item(s) for compilation. Status becomes `processing`. 3. **Converse**: Saddle compiles into CTX, LLM reads and works 4. **Resolve**: Conversation produces outcomes (or not) 5. **Mark done**: Update frontmatter with `status: done`, outcome type, refs 6. **Archive**: Periodically move old done items to `META/archive/inbox/`
skill.flow: ```mermaid flowchart LR Create[Create Item] --> Pending[status: pending] Pending --> Select[Select in Saddle] Select --> Processing[status: processing] Processing --> Converse[Conversation] Converse --> Done[status: done] Converse --> Deferred[status: deferred] Done --> Archive[Archive old items] ```
skill.outcomes:
What comes out of processing an inbox item:
- **ticket** - Work to be done, goes to `META/tickets/todo/` - **skill** - New or updated skill file - **spec** - Updates to app/library spec - **inbox** - New inbox item (decomposition, follow-up question) - **none** - Handled directly, no artifact needed
skill.sources: Where inbox items come from: - Human notes and ideas - Bugs discovered during work - Questions that need discussion - Cross-project issues (bugs in vendored libs) - Decomposed larger items - Follow-ups from conversations
skill.archive:
Periodically archive old done items: ```bash # Move items done more than 30 days ago find META/inbox -name "*.md" -mtime +30 -exec grep -l "status: done" {} \; | \ xargs -I {} mv {} META/archive/inbox/ ```
Archive is cold storage. Items there are searchable but not shown in active views.
skill.format:
```markdown --- status: pending --- # Title
Brief description of the item.
## Context - Relevant background - Related files or systems - Why this matters
## Questions - Clarifying questions if any - Options to consider ```
Keep items focused. One topic per item. Split if too big.
